implementation_summary: Added 'rename' command to CLI that calls TodoApp.rename() method. The fix includes: (1) TodoApp.rename() method to handle the rename operation, (2) 'rename' subparser with 'id' and 'text' arguments, (3) Handler in run_command() that calls app.rename() and sanitizes output with _sanitize_text().
acceptance_criteria_met: CLI has a 'rename <id> <text>' command that calls TodoApp.rename()
Running 'todo rename 1 new text' successfully updates todo text
Error handling for non-existent ID returns exit code 1
